DESCRIPTION_KR: ART DÉCO 1925’s : Endlessly Modern; Inspired by early designs by French watchmaker HERBELIN, the Art Deco collection was created in the late 1970s. Today it welcomes a new line, Art Déco 1925’s, with an initial model exclusively designed for women. In an influx of French elegance, its stylishly structured look is a fine tribute to the French artistic movement that came into its own at the 1925 International Exhibition of Modern Decorative and Industrial Arts in Paris.; PURE AND SIMPLE; Influenced by the Art Deco vocabulary of order, colour and geometry, the stainless steel case with a polished yellow gold PVD coating (22 x 29.50 mm) presents a decidedly graphic rectangular shape. Devoid of hour markers in order to emphasise the purity of the design, it presents stylised faceted hands that move discreetly below the watchmaker’s signature.

DESCRIPTION_KR: David, The Founder; Ever since I was a child, because my father, who worked in the watchmaking industry for over 30 years, used to take me with him to his workshop, I've loved watches... What's more, I'm particularly passionate about design and sport. Innovating, developing and conceptualizing a sports watch while remaining highly technical and affordable, that's what I like to do.; Origin; How do you trace the origin of a legend? Many versions have been written about the “Flying Dutchman”. Here's the one I like best, and which inspired me to create the Hollander model: The Flying Dutchman & early sketches of the Hollander by David Van Heim; This ship of the Dutch East India Company was known for making surprisingly fast journeys between Europe and Asia. Rumor had it that this unusual performance was due to the assistance of the devil, as some believed it literally flew on water. Legend has it that, after the famous vessel disappeared at sea, the crew and its captain became ghosts forever imprisoned on the ship. In exchange for immortality, the captain tore his heart from his chest to live again. The Hollander collection takes us adrift, following this fascinating legend: its two hearts, two movements, ensure the immortality of three GMTs (Europe, Asia and the USA), each of which retraces the ghost ship's journey.; The five Hollander models offer simultaneous reading of two time zones. They are therefore designed for the man of the world, inclined to the practice of large time discrepancies. Indispensable instruments for transcontinental travel or meetings, these timepieces have opted for a shape that rounds off the angles: a square whose sides bulge out from the torso, bowing out in their desire to offer more space.; Birth of the DVH Hollander watch From Geneva, the David Van Heim watch brand is particularly proud to unveil five attractive GMT models offering recognizable design, affordability and, as always, high-tech expertise.; Faithful to David Van Heim's identity codes of technical expertise, design and affordability, the Hollander collection manages to slip seamlessly into the heart of the contemporary watchmaking scene, with a name that already sounds so familiar.; Subtle technicality Punctuated laterally by two crowns, one for each movement, the Hollander is distinguished by its technical crown guard. On the left-hand side, this original mobile mechanism, fixed to the case, can be raised at will, giving the necessary adjustments an appreciable playful dimension. Another technical subtlety: the lugs surrounding the bracelet are topped by a screw on each side.; Aesthetic and functional checkerboard dial.; Covered with a checkerboard pattern of fine raised squares, the Hollander's dial is stylish and embellished by its appliques. The large Multieyes hour is more functional, indicating the date, day and 24-hour scale, while the smaller Zone 2 is more poetic, with its arc of a circle and stylized hourglass.

DESCRIPTION_KR: David Van Heim introduces today its Dual - Chronograph, a watch that seems designed to push the boundaries of time. Pushing all limits, David Van Heim is a brand that combines technology, design and accessibility. Called to generate crowd movements, this new piece comes straight from a still-hot mold.; A powerful timepiece, with a dual chronograph, created for the men of today. The model is resolutely faithful to the codes of the watch brand.; The striking case in brushed and polished steel of this Dual - Chronograph is made of 8 pieces, whichopens up paths of customization and multiple combinations. The watch is finished with removable horns, offering absolute comfort when worn - a touch of design, which gives to the 54 mm of this timepiece a bit of modesty. This watch, which has a racy look, is offered in several versions and will appeal to men both seeking sensations or traveling the world.; The Dual - Chronograph is already available in black PVD with white dial and blue hands, Bi-color pink and black PVD with Black Dial, and pink PVD with ivory and golden dial.; Today David Van Heim adds a touch of color to this collection with the presentation of the new Dual-Chronograph, with a case in brushed and polished steel and blue dial embellished with metal accents, offering perfect visibility.; The latter reveals two displays that overlap perfectly. The first, located on the left side, is complemented with Arabic numerals, the second meanwhile has Roman numerals. Each mini dial is equipped with artistically designed hands, providing quick visibility of information. This model has you seeing double with its double date (calendar retrograde on the right), its dual time and its double pushers located face to face that allow a setting and a fluid use of this double chronograph. This sporty piece is finished with a leather strap with blue stitching and has a pin buckle.; David Van Heim offers a watch with an attractive design which will seduce you with its bold shapes.

DESCRIPTION_KR: S3000C; Cyber Watches; NOW IS THE FUTURE; CYBER -Attitude To Future; With its highly distinctive geometric shape and a powerful metallic texture, "Cyber" has become a symbol of future technology in the minds of most people. Cyber embodies a sense of futurism, technology, and coolness. It has consistently held a significant place in the hearts of those filled with anticipation for future technology. Inspired by it, the BENLYDESIGN team has created a wristwatch to portray the values behind Cyber.; Unique OLED Display; The Cyber Watches adopts unique OLED display method, using extremely thin organic material coatings and ITO glass substrates. The liquid structure of OLED makes the display brighter and the colors more vivid, thus OLED is called the "Dream display", which is very rare in the field of watches.; The exterior design of the; All-Metal Cyber; The all-metal Cyber Watches are ready to take on any challenge, incredibly sturdy, tough, and durable.; Featuring an ultra-strong metal monocoque exoskeleton, they can reduce surface dents, damage, and corrosion caused by long-term use.; Environmentalism - The chips recycling from computers, and we have disassembled them to connect three LED lights. the LED lights will flash when the screen is awakened and during hourly time announcements.(The 3000GA-C-Green version does not include an LED lights.); Quick-release strap: Equipped with a rapid-release spring bar system, strap replacement requires no tools, making it convenient and swift.; Innovative OLED display; Raise-to-Wake function; The groundbreaking OLED display Raise-to-wake feature allows the Cyber Watches to quickly show the time when tilted at a 60° angle and held for 1 second.; BENLYDESIGN collaborated with a professional testing team to conduct over 100,000 rounds of testing, including walking swing tests, exercise swing tests, waving swing tests, sleep swing tests, and over 72 other possible scenarios of accidental touches. This effectively prevents the majority of accidental touches.This greatly extends the battery life.; Ultra comfort When designing the Cyber Watches, BENLYDESIGN aimed to maximize comfort. The ratio R100 curved case back of the Cyber Watches series ensures a perfect fit on the wrist from any angle, maximizing comfort. The development cost of this case back is tens of times higher than that of a regular flat case back. After tens of thousands of rounds of testing, we finally introduced this case back. This ensures the highest level of comfort, The weight of the Cyber Watches is 115g, and it is further enhanced for stability and comfort through center of gravity adjustment. BENLYDESIGN strives for excellence in every detail.
